goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: The package is fail-closed at both executable boundaries. The channel classifier accepts semantic readiness only for an exact per-route contract with targetMatched=true and searchEntryPresent=true. The browser harness additionally requires a semantic diagnostic for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Pinterest, validates every route and landmark against a per-channel allowlist, and emits only the bounded validated diagnostic. Entry preflight can pass before results exist, while an attempted query without successful interaction/results remains ui_change unless the native surface explicitly reports empty. Authenticated shell, Feed, and unavailable-target variants remain ui_change. Recovery guidance permits one evidenced in-origin native Search navigation activation inside the bounded operation, followed by the same projection, and prohibits guessed URLs/selectors, page text, broader reads, and a second attempt. Authenticated screenshot capture is rejected. No live readiness claim is made; fresh Chrome proof remains required.

requirement_to_test.requirement: Exact ready route, exact native entry, and targetMatched=true
Authenticated shell, Feed, and target-unavailable states fail visibly
Bounded recovery and authenticated privacy constraints

false_positive_analysis: Ready semantic routes cannot pass with targetMatched=false, a missing diagnostic, a non-ready route, a mismatched landmark, or a missing search entry.
LinkedIn authenticated Feed/navigation remains non-ready even when authentication and navigation are present.
Native empty is only emitted after a successful bounded interaction; preflight without interaction returns ready, never native_empty.
The TypeScript classifier is channel-agnostic, but all production browser acceptance is channel-aware in the harness; no other production caller bypasses that harness.
privacy_boundary_analysis: The host contract projects structural booleans plus enumerated route and landmark labels only.
The shared skill and QA runbook prohibit full tab lists, URLs, DOM/body/feed text, identities, credentials, cookies, tokens, screenshots, guessed selectors, and broader retry reads.
The harness rejects forbidden private fields, non-enumerated semantic diagnostics, and authenticated screenshot capture.
missing_evidence: The exact reviewed build must be committed and pinned into the dedicated QA repository.
Fresh one-time-authorized existing-Chrome evidence must exercise Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn; fixture and release verification do not prove current platform UI.
